svg.title: Education and experience
svg.desc: Experience. Abysalto Student AI/ML engineer Jan 2026 – present. I built order tools and the knowledge base API for a chatbot that handled nearly 30,000 production sessions. I checked replies against shipment data in Arize Phoenix. I now turn Excel price lists into records for our Django catalog. A file can have around 20,000 rows and 50 columns. Python, LangGraph, pgvector, OpenTelemetry. AI engineering intern Jul 2025 – Sep 2025. At Abysalto AI Academy, I connected Agent Studio to RAG Studio so agents could search the documents a user selected. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pytest. Education. University of Zagreb Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing MSc in Computing Oct 2025 – Jul 2027 (expected). Computer Science track BSc in Computing Oct 2021 – Jul 2025. For my thesis, I trained a convolutional neural network to classify seven facial expressions. Keras. Université de Tours Erasmus+ exchange at Polytech Tours Sep 2025 – Jan 2026. I segmented 15 crystal classes in microscopy images and classified medical notes by specialty. YOLO11, OpenCV, scikit-learn, BERT.
